package handler

import (
	"errors"
	db "example.com/slg-practice/db"
	player "example.com/slg-practice/game/entities/player"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"time"
)

type ISLGEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.PlayerDao
	TimerComp() *player.TimerComponent
}

var errSLGRule = errors.New("slg practice: invalid target, insufficient gold or unknown construction")

// 独立研究队列；目标等级是业务的幂等事实，与建造可同时推进。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSLGResearch(target ISLGEntity, level int64) (int64, error) {
	dao := target.Dao()
	if level <= 0 {
		return 0, errSLGRule
	}
	if level <= dao.GetResearchLevel() {
		return 0, nil
	}
	if level != dao.GetResearchLevel()+1 {
		return 0, errSLGRule
	}
	if id := dao.GetPendingResearch(); id != 0 {
		return id, nil
	}
	if dao.GetGold() < 5 {
		return 0, errSLGRule
	}
	dao.SetGold(dao.GetGold() - 5)
	id := target.TimerComp().NewTimer(3*time.Second, player.TimerResearch, 0, 0, nil)
	if id == 0 {
		return 0, errSLGRule
	}
	dao.SetPendingResearch(id)
	return id, nil
}

type ISLGTileEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.TileDao
}

// 地块归属与玩家支付同一事务提交；已占地块的竞争者不支付，同一拥有者重放不再扣。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSLGClaimTile(target ISLGEntity, tile ISLGTileEntity) (bool, error) {
	if owner := tile.Dao().GetOwnerID(); owner != 0 {
		return owner == target.ID(), nil
	}
	if target.Dao().GetGold() < 1 {
		return false, errSLGRule
	}
	tile.Dao().SetOwnerID(target.ID())
	target.Dao().SetGold(target.Dao().GetGold() - 1)
	return true, nil
}

// 用目标等级而不是短期请求去重环保证重复建造不重复扣款；本例只有一个建造队列。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSLGStart(target ISLGEntity, level int64, destination int64) (int64, error) {
	dao := target.Dao()
	if level <= 0 || destination <= 0 || destination > 1000 {
		return 0, errSLGRule
	}
	if level <= dao.GetBuildingLevel() {
		return 0, nil
	}
	if level != dao.GetBuildingLevel()+1 {
		return 0, errSLGRule
	}
	if pending := dao.GetPendingBuild(); pending != 0 {
		return pending, nil
	}
	if dao.GetGold() < player.BuildCost {
		return 0, errSLGRule
	}
	dao.SetGold(dao.GetGold() - player.BuildCost)
	id := target.TimerComp().NewTimer(2*time.Second, player.TimerBuild, destination, 0, nil)
	if id == 0 {
		return 0, errSLGRule
	}
	dao.SetPendingBuild(id)
	return id, nil
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerSLGCancel(target ISLGEntity, id int64) (bool, error) {
	if id <= 0 || target.Dao().GetPendingBuild() != id {
		return false, nil
	}
	if !target.TimerComp().RemoveTimer(id) {
		return false, errSLGRule
	}
	target.Dao().SetPendingBuild(0)
	target.Dao().SetGold(target.Dao().GetGold() + player.BuildCost)
	return true, nil
}
